summary: Source review found no product defect: the desktop-only CSS implements wrapping, compact laptop padding and metadata ellipsis while preserving full labels, handlers, the merged separate save-row placement, mobile rules, shared navigation and other pages. The Playwright suite meaningfully covers the required bilingual width matrix, overflow, control inventory, hit targets, keyboard access and mobile regressions. Root npm test discovers 221 tests including all 64 task cases; node tests/verify.js and git diff --check passed. The retained browser report records 53 passes with no skips or failures, and the inspected 1025px RO screenshot supports the reported layout; the tester reports 64 passes after expanding coverage. However, this review's independent run of all 64 cases failed before page execution because Chromium aborted at sandbox_host_linux.cc:41 with shutdown: Operation not permitted. Under the unattended reporting requirement, this is a failed review for an execution-environment blocker, not a demonstrated product regression. The reported Git commit blocker is historical: follow-up commits 51d508e and b60147f are present and the working tree was clean at review start.
findings: Complete independent final verification of the current 64-case suite in an authorized review environment where Chromium can launch: run npm test -- tests/02-adapt-the-menu-for-small-screens/laptop-header.spec.js and retain its results. The existing raw browser report covers the earlier 53-case suite; the current review produced no page measurements. Resolve the environment restriction without weakening assertions or changing product CSS merely to address a browser startup failure.
